criteria_definitions.QS-1: - **QS-1 Fidelity:** preserve evidence and disagreements; use correct epistemic labels; no unsupported product rationale.
criteria_definitions.QS-2: - **QS-2 Operational utility:** concise skills prescribe actions; index entries state what a deeper artifact answers; explanations/procedures are readable, scoped and non-redundant.
criteria_definitions.QS-3: - **QS-3 Simplicity:** every new mechanism names an acceptance need existing code cannot satisfy; no speculative framework, per-layer agent, vector store, bespoke database or mandatory deepening loop.
criteria_definitions.QS-5: - **QS-5 Evidence:** actual implementation/reader controls, anti-vacuity mutations where relevant, bounded semantic review and explicit scope of proof; review a fixed bar, not endless optional improvements.
criteria_definitions.CC-3: | CC-3 | Product purpose, behavior, contracts, decisions, impact and safe maintenance are supported, not merely titled. | AC-02 |
criteria_definitions.GO-I2: | GO-I2 | Observed behavior, authorized intent, interpretation and gaps remain distinguishable; a structural freshness check cannot promote semantic certainty. | AC-02, AC-04 |
criteria_definitions.GO-I3: | GO-I3 | Current reads bind exact artifact versions to an accepted scope/dependency manifest valid for current inputs/contracts; prior acceptance or rollback cannot make stale knowledge current. Historical reads are labelled. | AC-06, AC-07, AC-09 |
criteria_definitions.GO-I5: | GO-I5 | Source additions, changes, removals and relevant non-code changes enter impact analysis; unavailable impact is HOLD, not an empty successful worklist. | AC-06 |
criteria_definitions.GO-I7: | GO-I7 | Governed doors, secret handling, project boundaries and Knowledge/Memory separation remain intact. Imported source/docs/tool text is data, not execution authority. | AC-04, AC-09, AC-10 |
criteria_definitions.GO-I8: | GO-I8 | A scope, generation or artifact is not declared semantically complete just because its graph, source hashes, required sections or tests are complete. | AC-01, AC-02, AC-03 |
criteria_definitions.runtime-import-binding: Exact candidate, contract, each result and input identity plus all criteria separately reviewed by each of two independent judges; original semantic decisions do not substitute.

Kernel IDs are recorded, not independently recomputed by this verifier.
checks.PB-contract: 11 criteria and contract recorded; independent binding verdicts pending. The historical acceptance matches bodies, not automatic approval of transformed candidate.
checks.PB-inputs: All 15 input keys are sorted unique semantic keys plus exact protocol and historical driver; all input versions match the 251 candidate observations; all 251 observed SHA256 values match reconstructed files; all 37 dependencies resolve to earlier candidate results. Navigation is preserved in metadata, not treated as build dependency.
checks.PB-limits: Prepare only; no binding, governed publication, read/index, consumer or maintenance. Local identity claims are unauthenticated. Runtime release compatibility and policy remain separate gates. Tokens, billing and provider physical attempts UNKNOWN.
